兩種算法TWO WAYS TO COUNT

同一批文件，兩個差很多的數字The same pages, two very different numbers

目前對外宣稱的覆蓋率COVERAGE, AS PUBLISHED
78%
分母是全部頁面，分子是「曾經被翻譯過」的頁面。All pages below the line; pages ever translated above it.
與原文同版的比例IN STEP WITH THE SOURCE
31%
分子改成「翻譯版本等於當前原文版本」，數字掉了 47 個百分點。Change the numerator to “matches the current source version” and the figure drops 47 points.

兩個數字都沒有算錯，差別在於承不承認文件會改版。
註：本頁所有數字為版型示範用，並非任何真實專案的統計。Neither number is miscalculated. The difference is whether you admit that documentation changes.
Note: every figure on this page is illustrative, and describes no real project.

建議做法Recommendation
對外只公布同步率，覆蓋率降為內部指標。同時在建置流程加入一個檢查：原文檔案更新時，把對應的譯文標記為待更新，並自動開一則 issue。Publish only the sync rate; demote coverage to an internal metric. Add one check to the build: when a source file changes, mark its translations as pending and open an issue automatically.

審閱人力分布WHERE THE REVIEWERS ARE

三個語系靠一個人撐著Three locales rest on one person each

語系 ALocale A
6 人6
語系 BLocale B
4 人4
語系 CLocale C
3 人3
語系 DLocale D
2 人2
語系 E · F · GLocales E · F · G
各 1 人1 each

最後一列不是「人少」，是沒有備援。審閱者一旦停止參與，該語系的發行就停在原地，而且沒有任何流程會發現這件事。The last row is not “short-staffed”, it is unbacked. If that reviewer stops, the locale stops releasing, and no process in place would notice.
